svg.title: How Code Mode works
svg.desc: Without Code Mode, Claude asks for tool calls step by step, and the whole result of each call is added to its context before the next call. With Code Mode, Claude writes one piece of JavaScript that makes many tool calls, and only what that code returns is added to its context. In motion, it lights in order. Code Mode off: one round trip for every tool call: Code Mode off, then Claude, then The tool runs, then Claude's context, then Claude, then The tool runs, then Claude's context. Code Mode on: one script, one result: Code Mode on, then Claude, then The code runs, then Claude's context.
svg.text: Code Mode off: one round trip for every tool call
Code Mode on: one script, one result

g.text: many tool calls in one go
